scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "web,api" --prefix-colors "cyan,green" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run start:api"
scripts.test: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q && cd ../frontend && npx vitest run
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:frontend && bash -c 'cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt'
